name: One Track Mind

evidence.note: Band site says its goal is to keep beloved anthems alive on the dance floor; lists Babylon-area venues.
About page: members have decades of experience in Long Island club cover bands.

dancing.notes: A bar and brewery cover band whose stated goal is to keep favorite anthems going on the dance floor; freestyle dancing is likely.

description: South Shore Long Island cover band of veteran local musicians that gives familiar classic songs a modern twist at breweries, bars and street fairs.
genres: covers of classic hits with a modern twist
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Not the 2026 hip-hop act 'One Track Mind' on Apple Music or the Illinois classic-rock band of the same name.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current description is still accurate, so not replaced. The booking page also lists cell numbers for four band members by first name; these were left out (personal numbers) in favor of the band email and booking form. No logo file on the site (the band logo appears only on the drum head; the og:image is a promo photo), so logo left empty. Photos are from the band's own gallery and recent (2026). Venue name on the band site is "Tres Palm Restaurant".

evidence.note: Official site: reworks familiar classic songs with a modern twist for the dance floor; links Facebook and Instagram; lists Long Island venues such as Greenport Harbor Brewery, Lily's Babylon and Great South Bay Brewery.
Gig list includes Tres Palm Restaurant Oyster Fest, 16 East Ct., Babylon, Oct 4 2026, plus Deer Park, Peconic, Ronkonkoma, West Islip and Huntington dates.
Booking page with contact form, otmbandli@gmail.com and phone numbers for four band members.
Members: Phil Felice (vocals, guitar, keys), Frank Held (bass), Wayne Trefcer (drums), plus Tony; each with 40+ years playing Long Island and tri-state clubs.
